BÀI MẪU: Personally, I lean towards reading books. There's a myriad of advantages to it, like enriching vocabulary, refining language proficiency, and fostering imagination and creativity. Moreover, it cultivates critical thinking and analytical abilities as readers often delve into character analysis, plot intricacies, and thematic exploration. Additionally, reading serves as a stress-reliever, enhances concentration, and broadens one's horizons by acquainting them with diverse cultural perspectives.
CÂU HỎI: Reading books or playing games, which is better? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Both reading books and playing games hold their own value and strengths, so it's challenging for me to definitively say which is superior, as it greatly depends on personal preferences and objectives. While reading books provides a plethora of benefits, such as expanding vocabulary, enhancing language skills, and fostering imagination and critical thinking, it also enables readers to delve into new realms, acquire knowledge, and empathize with various characters and perspectives. Moreover, reading serves as a soothing and intellectually stimulating activity, offering a break from the daily grind. On the flip side, playing games also offers its own set of advantages. Certain games foster problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and hand-eye coordination. They also promote social interaction and teamwork, especially in multiplayer formats. Additionally, gaming serves as a form of entertainment and enjoyment, providing an outlet to unwind and have fun.

sp3-03.title: Bộ 3
sp3-03.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp3-03.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see in the two pictures? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Wow, these two pictures are really interesting, and they make me want to describe them right away. In my opinion, both pictures show very different activities that people might do in their daily lives. When I look at the first picture, it’s quite easy to see a man sitting by a large window and looking out at the city. He seems to be alone and deep in thought, possibly relaxing or reflecting on something. The cloudy sky and the wide city view create a calm and slightly contemplative atmosphere. While the second picture is a far cry from the first one. It shows a young man in a kitchen, preparing food. He is wearing an apron and cutting vegetables, which suggests that he is focused and actively involved in cooking. Unlike the first picture, this one feels more energetic and practical, showing someone engaged in a daily routine. Overall, the first picture represents a quiet moment of reflection, whereas the second one shows a more active and productive side of everyday life.
CÂU HỎI: Do you prefer spending time sitting alone or cooking in your free time? | 45
BÀI MẪU: I prefer spending time cooking in my free time. Cooking is not only a practical skill but also a creative outlet for me. I enjoy experimenting with different ingredients and trying out new recipes. It’s a satisfying process that allows me to relax and unwind while also being productive. Plus, there’s something rewarding about preparing a delicious meal and sharing it with others. While sitting alone and reflecting can be peaceful, I find that cooking gives me a sense of accomplishment and allows me to express my creativity in a tangible way.

sp3-04.title: Bộ 4
sp3-04.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp3-04.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see in the two pictures? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Wow, these two pictures are really captivating, and they make me want to dive right into describing them. In my view, both pictures depict children engaged in play, but in very different environments and activities.
In the first picture, it’s easy to see three children playing with toys indoors. They appear to be having a good time in what looks like a cozy, comfortable space, possibly a living room or a playroom. The toys are scattered around, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The children seem focused and happy, fully immersed in their play.
The second picture, however, contrasts sharply with the first. In this image, I can see a group of children playing outside, hula hooping in the sunlight. The setting is outdoors, surrounded by greenery with trees and grass, giving the scene a fresh, vibrant feel. The bright sunlight adds energy to the scene, and the children seem to be thoroughly enjoying the physical activity and the fresh air.
Both pictures beautifully capture the essence of play, but they do so in different contexts—one indoors with toys, and the other outdoors with hula hoops, highlighting the diversity of how children can enjoy themselves.
CÂU HỎI: How do children benefit from spending time in these ways? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Well, I believe that both activities are highly beneficial for children. They help children relax and alleviate stress, which is crucial for their overall well-being. Additionally, these activities are good for children's health, promoting physical fitness and mental stimulation. Furthermore, when children engage in these activities, they have the opportunity to make new friends, which is important for their social development and confidence.
CÂU HỎI: Why is it important for children to play together? | 45
BÀI MẪU: I believe playing together is essential for children for several reasons. Firstly, it makes the experience more enjoyable and fun for them. Secondly, it provides an excellent opportunity for children to easily make friends and build social connections. Playing together also helps them develop important social skills, such as teamwork and communication, which are crucial for their overall development.

sp3-05.title: Bộ 5
sp3-05.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp3-05.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see in the two pictures? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Wow, both of these pictures are really captivating, I can't stop talking
about them. In my view, they represent two different kinds of activities, each highlighting various travel destinations and experiences. When I look at the first picture, I see six people hiking in the mountains. From what I can tell, they seem to be tackling some challenging trails through high mountain peaks, something quite common in Europe. Moreover, they seem quite proud of themselves after completing this adventure. Now, the second picture is a complete contrast. In it, I see a tranquil and picturesque beach. As I see it, those who opt for beach vacations, like the one depicted, are often looking for relaxation and a break from their hectic lives. They immerse themselves in nature, letting go of all the stresses to rejuvenate their bodies.
CÂU HỎI: What's so attractive about these two places? | 45
BÀI MẪU: That's a great question, thank you for asking. Let me take a moment to think about it... Well, the attractiveness of these two places mainly lies in their natural beauty. Both the forests and beaches offer amazing experiences. In the forests, you can immerse yourself in nature, surrounded by trees and wildlife. It's a chance to reconnect with the natural world and maybe even learn some survival skills. On the other hand, beaches provide stunning golden sands and a peaceful atmosphere. They're perfect for relaxation and unwinding, whether you're sunbathing or taking a refreshing swim in the ocean. So, in short, the allure of these places is their breathtaking beauty and the different experiences they offer.
CÂU HỎI: How to protect natural beauty? | 45
BÀI MẪU: That's an interesting question. Let me share some ways to protect natural beauty. Firstly, raising awareness among visitors about the importance of preserving nature is crucial. Educating people about the fragility of ecosystems and how human actions can impact them can encourage responsible behavior. Another effective measure is to install warning signs in tourist areas, reminding people not to litter, smoke, or deface the environment with graffiti. These simple steps can help preserve the beauty of our natural landscapes for future generations to enjoy.

sp3-06.title: Bộ 6
sp3-06.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp3-06.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see in the two pictures? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Wow, both of these pictures are really interesting, and they immediately catch my attention. In my opinion, they clearly represent two different ways people read books nowadays: traditional reading and digital reading.
When I look at the first picture, it’s quite easy to see a young woman standing in a library and reading a printed book. She seems calm and fully focused on what she is reading. The shelves full of books around her create a quiet and academic atmosphere, which is ideal for deep concentration. This image represents a more traditional reading habit, where people often read to relax, gain knowledge, or enjoy the peaceful environment of a library.
While the second picture is a far cry from the first one. It shows a woman sitting at a desk and carefully reading on a computer screen, almost as if she were reading a digital book. She looks highly concentrated, with one hand on the keyboard to scroll the screen and the other touching her hair. There are several items on the desk, suggesting a comfortable and modern workspace. Unlike the first picture, this one highlights the convenience and flexibility of reading using electronic devices.
Overall, both pictures reflect how reading habits have evolved, combining the traditional experience of paper books with the modern advantages of digital technology.
CÂU HỎI: Do you prefer reading printed books or ebooks? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Both reading printed books and ebooks have their unique features. Printed books offer a tangible reading experience that many people find enjoyable. They provide a sense of satisfaction in turning physical pages, and some people appreciate the smell and feel of a book. Additionally, printed books don't require any electronic devices, making them accessible anytime, anywhere. On the other hand, ebooks offer several advantages. They are portable and convenient, allowing readers to carry an entire library on a single device.
Ebooks often provide features like adjustable font sizes, built-in dictionaries, and the ability to highlight and take notes. They also offer instant access to a vast selection of titles, often at lower prices than printed books.
Due to the demands of my job and limited free time, I prefer reading ebooks. Ebooks are portable and can be used on any device, so I can take them anywhere without any hassle.
CÂU HỎI: Does technology affect the way we read books? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Yes, technology certainly affects how we read books. The progress in technology is significantly changing our reading habits. In the past, people used to read printed books to gain knowledge or find material. They bought them from stores or borrowed them from libraries. However, nowadays, with the help of technology, people can read books on their laptops or phones. Many books are available on the internet for free, allowing people to access reading materials without any cost.

sp3-07.title: Bộ 7
sp3-07.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp3-07.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see in the two pictures? What do you think are the benefits of these two different types of activities for children? Do you think children nowadays spend enough time playing outdoors? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Tranh mẹ và con gái đang trong cửa hàng đồng hồ sang trọng, và tranh mẹ và con gái đang mua quần áo ngoài chợ

sp4-01.title: Đề 1
sp4-01.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-01.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time you changed your job or school.
CÂU HỎI: Do you think it's a good idea to change jobs often? Why or why not?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, how important is change in people's lives?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Well, I can certainly speak about this from my own experience, because a few years ago I decided to change my job after working for the same company for quite a long time. At that point, I had already mastered most of my daily tasks, and although the working environment was comfortable, I started to feel that my career was no longer progressing. As a result, I made the decision to move to a new company where I would face more challenges and responsibilities.
At the beginning, this change affected me quite strongly. I was under a lot of pressure because I had to adapt to a new working culture, learn unfamiliar systems, and prove myself again. If I’m honest, there were moments when I doubted my decision, especially during the first few months. However, looking back now, I would say it was definitely a positive experience. I became more confident, more independent, and much better at managing stress. If I had stayed in my old job, I probably wouldn’t have developed these skills.
In my opinion, although stability is important, I strongly believe that it is better to embrace change in life, especially when change leads to personal growth. Staying in the same situation for too long can make people feel comfortable but also unmotivated. Change pushes us out of our comfort zone and forces us to learn new things. That being said, change should be a well-considered decision rather than an impulsive one. Overall, I think a balance between stability and change is ideal, but without change, real progress is almost impossible.

sp4-02.title: Đề 2
sp4-02.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-02.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time you learned something new.
CÂU HỎI: What do you think about the belief that older people don't learn anything new, is it correct?
CÂU HỎI: Why? What are your thoughts on the idea that it's never too late, whether you're young or old, to start learning a new skill?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Well, when I think about learning something new, one experience that stands out is when I was promoted to a managerial position at a software company about a year ago. It was an exciting opportunity, but at the same time, I quickly realized that the role required a completely different set of skills. I had to learn how to manage my time effectively, prioritize tasks, and delegate work fairly to my team. In addition, improving my communication skills was essential, as I needed to motivate my team and handle conflicts in a professional way.
At first, the learning process was quite challenging, and I often felt overwhelmed. However, instead of giving up, I actively looked for ways to improve by attending training courses, reading management books, and learning from feedback. Gradually, I became more confident, and my team started working more efficiently. Looking back, learning these new skills not only helped me perform better at work but also made me more self-assured as a leader.
Regarding the belief that older people cannot learn anything new, I strongly disagree with this idea. I think learning ability is not determined by age but by attitude. Although older people may learn more slowly than younger ones, they usually have more life experience, which actually helps them understand and apply new knowledge more effectively.
Finally, I completely agree with the idea that it is never too late to start learning a new skill. Learning should be a lifelong process, regardless of age. Whether someone is young or old, learning something new keeps the mind active, increases confidence, and helps people adapt to changes in life. Overall, I believe that as long as we are willing to learn, there are always opportunities to grow and improve ourselves.

sp4-03.title: Đề 3
sp4-03.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-03.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time you worked with a younger partner or older people?
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: Do you prefer working with the younger people or older ones?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Well, I clearly remember a time when I worked with both younger and older colleagues on a large project at my company. It was a cross-functional team, and the age difference among team members was quite noticeable. One of my teammates was a senior colleague who had over twenty years of experience, while another was a young employee who had just graduated and joined the company not long before that.
At the beginning, I found this experience quite challenging. The older colleague was very careful and methodical, and he preferred to rely on proven solutions and past experience. On the other hand, the younger colleague was energetic, creative, and always willing to experiment with new ideas and technologies. Sometimes, their opinions conflicted, which made teamwork more complicated. Personally, I felt a bit pressured because I often had to adjust my communication style and act as a bridge between them to make sure everyone felt heard and respected.
However, as the project progressed, my feelings gradually changed. I started to appreciate the strengths of both age groups. The older colleague helped us avoid mistakes by sharing valuable insights and anticipating potential risks, while the younger team member brought fresh perspectives and innovative approaches that improved our final results. Because of this, I felt more confident, motivated, and satisfied with the teamwork.
In terms of preference, I don’t think working exclusively with younger or older people is ideal. I strongly believe that a mixed-age team is the most effective. Older people contribute experience, stability, and a calm approach to problem-solving, whereas younger people add creativity, enthusiasm, and flexibility. When these qualities are combined, the working environment becomes more balanced, productive, and enjoyable.

sp4-04.title: Đề 4
sp4-04.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-04.body:
CÂU HỎI: Have you ever been asked to do work that you didn’t want to do?
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel after completing that task?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, what can people gain from accepting work that is not something they enjoy?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Yes, I have definitely experienced a situation where I was asked to do work that I didn’t really want to do. A few months ago, I worked with three friends on a university presentation for our final semester. At the beginning, we were very motivated because we had chosen a topic related to environmental issues, which we all found meaningful and interesting. We invested a lot of time in researching, collecting materials from different sources, and even asking lecturers for advice to improve our ideas.
However, everything changed unexpectedly in the final week when our instructor suddenly decided to change our topic to transportation. To be honest, we were shocked and quite frustrated because most of our previous work became useless overnight. None of us were particularly interested in the new topic, and the deadline was extremely tight. Despite our reluctance, we understood that we had no choice but to accept the situation. We quickly reorganized our plan, divided the tasks more efficiently, redesigned all the slides, and even asked other classmates for support. It was stressful, but we worked together and stayed focused on the goal.
After completing the task, I felt a huge sense of relief, followed by pride. Surprisingly, our presentation turned out to be very successful, and we received the highest score in the class. Although it was not something I enjoyed at first, the experience helped me realize that I am capable of handling pressure and adapting to unexpected changes.
In my opinion, when people accept work that they don’t necessarily enjoy, they can gain many valuable benefits. First, they develop important skills such as discipline, perseverance, and adaptability, which are essential in both academic and professional life. In reality, not every task will match our interests, but completing these tasks responsibly helps build a strong work ethic. Moreover, these experiences often push people out of their comfort zones and allow them to discover strengths they didn’t know they had. Overall, I believe that doing unpleasant tasks can still lead to personal growth and prepare us better for real-life challenges.

sp4-05.title: Đề 5
sp4-05.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-05.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you laughed loudly with your friends.
CÂU HỎI: What do you think of a cheerful person?
CÂU HỎI: Why do people laugh at different things?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: One of the most memorable moments when I laughed uncontrollably with my friends happened about a year ago during a weekend trip. A group of close friends and I decided to explore a small town near the countryside. Everything was going smoothly until we accidentally took a wrong turn and ended up in a quiet village that none of us had ever visited before. Instead of panicking, we decided to walk around and enjoy the moment.
While wandering through the village, we came across a tiny antique shop run by an elderly owner with a very humorous personality. He started telling us exaggerated and funny stories about the old objects in his shop, using dramatic gestures and expressions. His storytelling was so entertaining that we couldn’t stop laughing, and soon our laughter became completely contagious. The situation itself wasn’t particularly funny, but the relaxed atmosphere, combined with his sense of humor, made the moment unforgettable. Even now, whenever we talk about that day, it immediately brings a smile to my face.
Personally, I have a very positive opinion of cheerful people. I find them inspiring because their optimism and positive energy can easily influence those around them. Being with cheerful individuals makes social interactions more enjoyable and helps reduce stress, especially in difficult situations. They often create a comfortable environment where people feel relaxed and accepted.
As for why people laugh at different things, I believe it largely depends on personal background, culture, and life experiences. What one person finds hilarious may seem ordinary to someone else. Our sense of humor is shaped by our personality and the situations we have been through. Overall, laughter is a universal emotion, but the reasons behind it are highly individual, which is what makes human interaction so interesting.

sp4-06.title: Đề 6
sp4-06.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-06.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you visited a forest.
CÂU HỎI: How did that experience make you feel?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, why is spending time in nature important for people today?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: I’ve had the opportunity to explore several forests in my life, but one experience that left a deep impression on me was my visit to the Samu Forest a few years ago. At that time, my life felt quite overwhelming due to work and personal pressures, and I often felt mentally exhausted. I decided to take a short trip to reconnect with nature, hoping it would help me clear my mind.
From the moment I entered the Samu Forest, my mood began to change. The forest felt almost magical, with ancient trees covered in moss, a wide variety of plants, and mist floating gently through the air. What impressed me the most was how clean and untouched the environment was. There was no noise, no pollution, and no litter—just pure silence and fresh air. Walking through the forest gave me a sense of solitude, but it wasn’t lonely. Instead, it felt calm and comforting, as if nature itself was offering me a moment to slow down and reflect.
After spending time there, I felt much lighter, more relaxed, and emotionally refreshed. The peaceful atmosphere helped me face my own thoughts more honestly and reduced the stress I had been carrying for a long time. I left the forest feeling re-energized and more positive about life.
In my opinion, spending time in nature is extremely important for people nowadays, especially in modern societies where life is fast-paced and stressful. Nature provides a natural escape from technology and daily pressures, allowing people to recharge both mentally and emotionally. It also helps individuals develop a deeper appreciation for the environment and understand the importance of protecting it. Overall, experiences like visiting a forest remind us to slow down, reconnect with ourselves, and find balance in our lives.

sp4-07.title: Đề 7
sp4-07.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-07.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a challenging experience you have faced in your life.
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel before and after overcoming this challenge?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, what can people gain from facing difficult challenges?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Hello, my name is Anna Mai. When reflecting on the topic of challenges, one significant experience that comes to my mind is my journey to lose body fat and improve my physical fitness. Some time ago, I realized that I was carrying extra weight, which negatively affected my confidence and even made me feel older than my actual age. This realization encouraged me to set a clear goal: to lose five kilograms within two months.
To achieve this, I joined a nearby gym and worked with a personal trainer who designed a workout schedule and a suitable diet plan for me. The process was far from easy. I had to manage strong food cravings, wake up early to exercise regularly, and stay disciplined even on days when I felt tired or unmotivated. Before starting this challenge, I felt both determined and slightly anxious because I knew it would require a great deal of self-control.
During the journey, there were moments of exhaustion and self-doubt, but I kept reminding myself why I had started. After reaching my target, I felt extremely proud and confident. Not only did I achieve my weight-loss goal, but I also became healthier, more energetic, and mentally stronger. This success had a very positive impact on my self-esteem and overall well-being.
From a broader perspective, I strongly believe that facing difficult challenges helps people grow in many ways. Challenges push us out of our comfort zones and allow us to discover abilities we didn’t know we had. They also build resilience, discipline, and problem-solving skills. In general, overcoming challenges gives people a strong sense of achievement, which can motivate them to take on even bigger goals in the future.

sp4-08.title: Đề 8
sp4-08.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-08.body:
CÂU HỎI: Do you often work in teams to complete assignments?
CÂU HỎI: What are the benefits of working in teams?
CÂU HỎI: How do you work in teams if you're in different cities?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Yes, I often work in teams to complete assignments, especially during my school years and university studies. One memorable experience was when I worked in a group of four students on a project for an environmental exhibition held annually in December in my hometown. The purpose of the exhibition was to raise public awareness about pollution and environmental protection.
At the beginning, our team faced some difficulties in brainstorming ideas for the project. We weren’t sure how to present such a broad topic in a clear and creative way. Fortunately, our teacher guided us and encouraged us to focus on different types of pollution, such as air, water, and noise pollution. We collected information from various sources, including the internet, libraries, and magazines, and worked together to design slides and a model that explained the causes, impacts, and possible solutions. Although presenting our project in front of an audience was quite nerve-wracking for me at first, the support and encouragement from my teammates helped me gain confidence. In the end, we won first prize, which was a very proud moment for all of us.
In my opinion, working in teams brings many benefits. First, it allows people to share ideas and learn from one another, which often leads to better results than working alone. Teamwork also helps develop important skills such as communication, cooperation, and problem-solving. Moreover, working in a team can reduce pressure, as responsibilities are shared rather than carried by one person.
When team members are in different cities, I believe effective teamwork is still possible through online collaboration. Using digital tools such as video calls, shared documents, and messaging apps makes communication easier and faster. As long as team members set clear goals, communicate regularly, and respect each other’s responsibilities, distance does not have to be a barrier to successful teamwork.

sp4-09.title: Đề 9
sp4-09.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-09.body:
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel when you achieved your goal?
CÂU HỎI: How should people be encouraged to achieve their goals?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: One achievement that I’m particularly proud of happened quite recently. About two weeks ago, my company organized a banner design competition to celebrate its 20th anniversary. Even though I’m not a professional designer, I’ve always been passionate about creativity and visual communication, so I decided to take part in the competition. To prepare, I spent a lot of time researching the company’s 20-year history and carefully studying the theme and color requirements set by the organizers.
I worked through several drafts, combining my own ideas with feedback from friends and colleagues. At times, the process was tiring and frustrating because I wasn’t fully confident in my design skills. However, I continued improving my work by taking online design courses and learning from people who had more experience in this field. In the end, all the effort paid off, and my design was ranked first across the entire company.
When I achieved my goal, I felt extremely proud and satisfied. Seeing my banner being used in all the company’s anniversary events was incredibly rewarding. The congratulations from my colleagues, friends, and family made the achievement even more meaningful and boosted my confidence a lot. It made me realize that hard work and persistence can truly lead to success, even if you start with limited experience.
In my opinion, people should be encouraged to achieve their goals through both emotional and practical support. Encouragement from friends, family, or colleagues can help people stay motivated during difficult moments. In addition, setting clear goals and having a realistic plan makes the journey less overwhelming. When people feel supported and know exactly what they are working towards, they are much more likely to stay committed and achieve their goals.

sp4-10.title: Đề 10
sp4-10.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-10.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when someone helped you.
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel about that experience?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, why is helping others important in modern society?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: One experience when someone helped me that I still remember clearly happened about a month ago. I was on my way home from work late in the evening when it suddenly started raining very heavily. Unfortunately, I had forgotten my raincoat at home, and there were no nearby shops or houses where I could take shelter. At that moment, I felt helpless and accepted that I would probably get completely soaked.
While I was walking in the rain, a young woman on a motorbike suddenly stopped next to me. She called out to me and offered me a spare raincoat she was carrying. At first, I was quite surprised and a little hesitant, as I had always been warned to be careful with strangers. However, her calm voice and kind expression made me feel safe, so I accepted her offer. She smiled warmly and even insisted that I keep the raincoat. I watched her ride away before continuing my journey home.
After I got home, I was still in shock, but at the same time, I felt deeply touched and grateful. That small act of kindness from a complete stranger made me feel warmer, not just physically but emotionally as well. It reminded me that kindness still exists in everyday life, even among people who don’t know each other.
In my opinion, helping others is extremely important in modern society, where people are often busy and focused on their own lives. Simple acts of kindness can make a huge difference and help build trust and connection between individuals. Moreover, when people help one another without expecting anything in return, it creates a more caring and supportive community. I believe that these small actions can inspire others to be kinder and make society a better place overall.

sp4-11.title: Đề 11
sp4-11.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-11.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time when you had many choices.
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: Do you think we have so many choices to decide?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Hello, my name is Anna Mai. When I think about a time when I had many choices, I immediately remember the period after I finished high school, when I had to decide which university to attend. At that time, I had several strong options, including NEU, HANU, and FTU. Each university had its own advantages, which made the decision even more difficult.
To make the best choice, I spent about a week carefully comparing my options. I read reviews from former students, researched academic programs, and thought deeply about my long-term career goals, personal strengths, and interests. The process was quite stressful because I didn’t want to make the wrong decision. However, after gathering enough information and reflecting on what I truly wanted, I finally made my choice on my own.
When I reached my decision, I felt both relieved and proud. Although the process was challenging, it was also very rewarding. Making such an important decision independently boosted my confidence and helped me trust my own judgment. Looking back, I believe that taking the time to evaluate all the options carefully was the right approach.
Regarding the broader question, I strongly believe that people today have more choices than ever before. In modern life, we are constantly required to make decisions, from major ones like career paths to small daily choices such as what to eat or how to spend our free time. On the positive side, having many choices allows people to personalize their lives and pursue what suits them best. However, too many options can also lead to stress and decision fatigue, making it harder to feel satisfied with our final decisions. Overall, I think learning how to manage choices effectively is an essential skill in today’s world.

sp4-12.title: Đề 12
sp4-12.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-12.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you read a really good book.
CÂU HỎI: How did reading that book make you feel?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, why is reading books important for people in general?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: I’ve read quite a lot of good books in my life, but one that left a particularly strong impression on me is a book called “Rich Dad, Poor Dad.” I read it about four months ago during a trip to Binh Duong province with some of my close friends. We were going to a stadium to watch a football match, and while walking past a small bookstore nearby, the book’s eye-catching cover immediately attracted my attention. Out of curiosity, I started reading a few pages and quickly became interested in its content.
As I continued reading, I realized that the book offered valuable lessons, especially for someone like me who is interested in business and personal finance. It explains why some people struggle financially while others manage to build wealth, and it presents these ideas through simple and practical examples. I decided to buy the book right away and finished it shortly afterward. Since then, I’ve even tried to apply some of its ideas to the way I think about money and career planning.
Reading this book made me feel inspired and motivated. Every time I revisit it, I feel a sense of excitement and satisfaction, as if I’m discovering new insights each time. It not only changed my perspective on money but also encouraged me to think more independently and confidently about my future.
In my opinion, reading books is extremely important for people in general. Books help expand our knowledge, improve critical thinking, and allow us to learn from other people’s experiences. In today’s fast-paced world, reading also gives us a chance to slow down, reflect, and gain deeper understanding. Overall, I believe that reading good books can have a long-lasting positive impact on both personal development and lifelong learning.

sp4-13.title: Đề 13
sp4-13.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-13.body:
CÂU HỎI: What do you use the Internet for?
CÂU HỎI: Many people say that the Internet has a bad impact on people.
CÂU HỎI: What do you think? In your opinion, how can people use the Internet in a more positive and responsible way?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: The Internet plays a very important role in my daily life, especially because I work in the field of technology and online education. As a result, I use the Internet on a daily basis, usually for around eight hours during working hours. I mainly rely on it for professional purposes, such as sending and receiving emails, storing documents on cloud platforms, attending online meetings, and communicating with clients and colleagues. Without the Internet, it would be extremely difficult for me to complete my work effectively.
Besides work, I also use the Internet for learning and self-development. In the evenings, I often search for online courses, articles, and study materials to improve my knowledge and skills. Additionally, the Internet is a useful source of entertainment for me. I sometimes watch movies, listen to music, use social media, or stay in touch with friends who live far away.
Regarding the opinion that the Internet has a bad impact on people, I believe this statement is only partly true. On the one hand, the Internet has brought many positive changes, such as easier access to information, global communication, and opportunities for online education and remote work. These benefits have made life more convenient and flexible for many people. On the other hand, excessive use of the Internet, especially social media, can lead to addiction, reduced face-to-face interaction, and mental health issues such as stress or anxiety. Problems like cyberbullying, privacy risks, and the spread of misinformation are also serious concerns.
In my opinion, the key to using the Internet positively lies in balance and responsibility. People should manage their screen time, choose reliable sources of information, and use the Internet mainly as a tool for learning, working, and meaningful communication. If used wisely and in moderation, the Internet can greatly improve our quality of life rather than harm it.

sp4-14.title: Đề 14
sp4-14.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-14.body:
CÂU HỎI: Can you tell me about a time when you helped someone?
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel after helping that person?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, why is helping others important in society today?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: In my life, I have had several opportunities to help other people, but one experience in particular has stayed in my mind. Today, I’d like to talk about a time when I helped a stranger, which turned out to be a very meaningful moment for me.
This happened about four months ago on a cold evening near my house. I was on my way to attend a class when I noticed an elderly man sitting on the roadside and begging. It was still early in the morning, and the weather was quite chilly. At first, I thought about giving him some money from my bag. However, after a moment of hesitation, I realized that providing him with food might be more practical and helpful.
So, I went to a nearby market and bought five fresh stuffed buns along with a cup of warm soy milk. When I returned and handed him the food, I also said a few kind words to encourage him. I could clearly see the gratitude on his face as he accepted the warm meal, and that moment really touched me.
After helping him, I felt genuinely happy and satisfied. It made me realize that even a small action can have a big impact on someone’s life, especially when they are in a difficult situation. Helping that man not only made his day better, but it also gave me a strong sense of inner peace and fulfillment.
From a broader perspective, I believe helping others is extremely important in today’s society. Acts of kindness help strengthen social bonds, create a sense of community, and make the world a more compassionate place. Even simple gestures, such as offering food, time, or emotional support, can inspire others to do the same. In my opinion, if more people were willing to help one another, our society would become more caring, supportive, and united.

sp4-15.title: Đề 15
sp4-15.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-15.body:
CÂU HỎI: Can you tell me about a time when you tried an extreme sport?
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel before and after taking part in that activity?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, should extreme sports be encouraged, and who should be allowed to take part in them?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: One memorable experience I’ve had with extreme sports was when I decided to try bungee jumping. It was a daring decision and definitely marked an important moment in my journey of stepping out of my comfort zone.
On that day, as I stood on the edge of the platform, I felt an intense mix of fear and excitement. My heart was pounding, and when I looked down, the ground seemed unbelievably far away. The idea of jumping into the unknown was both thrilling and terrifying at the same time.
Before the jump, the instructors carefully checked all the safety equipment and explained the procedure in detail, which helped me feel more secure. When I finally gathered enough courage to leap, everything happened so fast. For a few seconds, I felt as if I were flying. As I fell, a powerful sense of freedom washed over me, and all my fear suddenly turned into excitement. After the jump, I felt extremely relieved, proud, and energized. It was an unforgettable experience that boosted my confidence and taught me how strong I could be when facing fear.
From a broader perspective, I believe extreme sports can be a great way for people to challenge themselves and build mental strength, but they should be approached with caution. In my opinion, such activities are more suitable for adults who are physically and mentally mature enough to understand the risks and follow safety rules. Extreme sports require self-control, responsibility, and proper training. For children, it may be better to encourage safer sports like swimming, football, or basketball, which still promote physical fitness without unnecessary danger.

sp4-16.title: Đề 16
sp4-16.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-16.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time when you encountered an impressive work of art
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: Do you believe that creativity plays a crucial role in its creation?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: In my life, I’ve had the opportunity to see many remarkable works of art in different museums, and each of them has left a certain impression on me. However, the most unforgettable experience took place about a year ago, when I visited an art museum with a group of close college friends.
At that time, we were on a short break, and one of my friends, who comes from Bac Giang province, invited us to visit his hometown. After spending some time with his family, he suggested that we visit a local museum, which displayed several well-known paintings by famous Vietnamese artists. Since it was nearby, we decided to go there together.
As soon as I entered the museum, my attention was immediately drawn to the largest painting on display, entitled “Country.” The artwork depicted a peaceful Vietnamese village, with farmers working diligently in the rice fields. In the background, there was a gentle image of Uncle Ho, smiling warmly at the villagers. I stood in front of that painting for nearly an hour, completely absorbed in its details and atmosphere.
While looking at it, I felt an overwhelming sense of pride, love, and emotional connection to my country. The painting reminded me of traditional values, simplicity, and the strong bond between people and their homeland. Even now, when I think back on that moment, I still feel deeply moved and genuinely happy.
Regarding the final question, I strongly believe that creativity plays a crucial role in the creation of meaningful artworks. Without creativity, a painting would simply be a visual representation of reality. In this case, the artist didn’t just paint a village scene; they used creativity to convey emotions, history, and national identity. It is this creative element that allows artworks to touch people’s hearts and become truly memorable.

sp4-17.title: Đề 17
sp4-17.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-17.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time you went to visit an amusement park
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: Do people in your country often visit amusement parks?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: In my life, I’ve been fortunate enough to visit several amusement parks, and each trip has left me with wonderful memories. However, the most memorable visit happened about six months ago, and I’d like to share that experience with you.
On that occasion, I went to Phu Quoc with my close friend, Anna Mai. We are very close and often travel together. The idea of visiting an amusement park had been in our minds since the previous year, but due to our busy schedules, we kept postponing it. Eventually, we decided to make it happen and chose Vinpearl Land in Phu Quoc as our destination.
Unfortunately, because we weren’t familiar with the route, we got lost along the way and arrived almost three hours later than planned. By the time we reached the park around noon, we were already quite tired and hungry. After having a quick lunch, we wasted no time and jumped straight into the activities.
The park offered a wide range of exciting attractions, such as racing games, water slides, and especially a high-speed roller coaster. The roller coaster ride left the strongest impression on me. My heart was pounding with every twist and sudden drop, and both Anna and I couldn’t stop screaming, not out of fear but pure excitement. It was thrilling, unforgettable, and incredibly fun.
Looking back, I still feel extremely happy and relaxed whenever I think about that day. It was a perfect way to escape from daily stress and create lasting memories with a close friend.
Regarding the final question, I believe that people in my country do often visit amusement parks, especially as living standards continue to improve. Nowadays, families place a higher value on leisure and quality time together. During weekends and summer holidays, parents frequently take their children to amusement parks for entertainment and bonding. As a result, many amusement parks constantly upgrade their facilities and introduce new attractions to meet this growing demand.

sp4-18.title: Đề 18
sp4-18.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-18.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you asked an important question.
CÂU HỎI: How did you ask that question?
CÂU HỎI: Which subject do people find the most difficult, even though they think they understand it, and therefore ask the most questions?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: In my daily life and work, I often face new challenges, and when that happens, asking questions becomes an important way for me to solve problems. One particular experience clearly stands out in my mind.
A couple of weeks ago, my team encountered a serious issue just as we were about to complete an important project. The system’s performance suddenly became unstable, and despite several discussions, we couldn’t identify the exact cause. Realizing that we needed expert advice, I decided to ask my manager, Mr. Michael, who has extensive experience in this field. Before approaching him, I prepared carefully. I reviewed the entire project process, identified the stages where the problem might have occurred, and came up with three possible solutions. Instead of asking a vague question, I clearly explained the situation, presented my ideas, and asked for his opinion on which solution would be the most effective. I also asked whether there were any risks we had overlooked.
Thanks to his guidance, our team managed to fix the problem and improve the system’s performance within just one day. I felt relieved and proud, not only because the project was delivered on time, but also because I learned how important it is to ask clear and well-prepared questions.
Regarding the final question, I believe mathematics is the subject that people often find the most difficult, even though they think they understand it. Many concepts seem simple at first, but once people start applying them to real problems, they realize there are many hidden rules and exceptions. As a result, learners tend to ask a lot of questions in order to fully understand the subject.

sp4-19.title: Đề 19
sp4-19.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-19.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you were asked a difficult question.
CÂU HỎI: How did you deal with that question, and how did you feel afterward?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, why are difficult questions important in learning or education?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: In my life, I’ve encountered several challenging questions, but one particular experience stands out clearly in my memory. It happened about four months ago when I was working on a presentation with three of my university classmates, namely Nam, Tuan, and Hung.
At that time, we were preparing for our final exam, and the topic we chose was environmental pollution. While we felt confident about the general content, our instructor suddenly asked us a very difficult question: “What was the exact number of deaths caused by environmental pollution in Vietnam in 2022?” We were completely taken aback because none of us had prepared such specific data, and honestly, we had never come across that information before. Instead of panicking, we decided to take the question seriously and treat it as a learning opportunity. We divided the work and started doing extensive research. We searched for information in libraries, on reliable websites, and even consulted other students and academic reports. After nearly two weeks of persistent effort, we finally found credible data and successfully incorporated it into our presentation.
In the end, our hard work paid off. The presentation received positive feedback and a good score from our teachers. Looking back, I felt extremely proud and satisfied, not only because we answered the question, but also because we learned how to deal with unexpected challenges calmly and effectively.
From a broader perspective, I believe difficult questions play a crucial role in education. They push students to go beyond surface-level knowledge and encourage critical thinking, research skills, and teamwork. Although such questions can be stressful at first, they often lead to deeper understanding and long-term learning.

sp4-20.title: Đề 20
sp4-20.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-20.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time you saved money?
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: What are the benefits of money saving?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Hello, I’m Anna Mai. Thinking about this topic reminds me of a time when I set a clear financial goal and successfully managed to save money for something meaningful, and I’d like to share that experience.
Last November, I decided to start saving money in order to buy an Apple laptop, specifically the MacBook Air M3. At that time, I was using a company-issued laptop, which worked reasonably well but had several limitations, especially in terms of graphics performance and portability. After doing some research and comparing different options, I realized that the MacBook Air M1 would better suit my work needs. To achieve this goal, I created a simple saving plan and set aside a fixed amount of money each month. I avoided unnecessary spending, such as eating out frequently or buying non-essential items. It took me around three months to save enough money to finally make the purchase.
When I finally bought the laptop, I felt extremely proud and satisfied. It gave me a strong sense of accomplishment because it was the result of my own discipline and planning. More importantly, the laptop has significantly improved my work efficiency, especially during meetings with clients and when handling project-related tasks. It also boosted my confidence in my ability to manage my personal finances effectively.
Regarding the final question, I believe saving money offers many long-term benefits. Firstly, it provides financial security and helps people prepare for unexpected situations. Secondly, saving allows individuals to afford important and meaningful purchases without relying on debt. Finally, developing a habit of saving encourages mindful spending, helping people distinguish between what they truly need and what they simply want.

sp4-21.title: Đề 21
sp4-21.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-21.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe a time you received good news What do you think about information being easily accessible through various channels?
CÂU HỎI: Today, the amount of information that people receive daily is vast.
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, what should recipients pay attention to?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: In my life, I’ve received important news in many different ways, but one particular experience stands out clearly in my memory. About four months ago, my friends and I took part in a competition to create an environmental model for our hometown’s annual December fair.
Our project focused on environmental pollution, including air, water, and noise pollution. The team consisted of Nam, Hoang, Linh, and myself. Throughout the preparation process, we faced several challenges, especially when collecting accurate data and organizing our ideas. Fortunately, our teacher, Ms. Pham, supported and guided us step by step. We gathered information from various sources, such as the internet and the library, to strengthen our project. On the day of the competition, presenting our model in front of a large audience made me extremely nervous. However, the encouragement from my teammates helped me stay calm and confident. Two days later, while we were studying in the library, we received an email announcing the results. To our complete surprise, we had won first prize. At first, we couldn’t believe it and even contacted the organizers to confirm the information. When it was verified, we felt an overwhelming sense of joy and pride, and our teacher was also delighted by the news.
Regarding the second question, I believe that having easy access to information through various channels, such as email, social media, and news websites, is both convenient and powerful. It allows people to stay informed quickly and efficiently. However, this also means that false or misleading information can spread just as easily.
Finally, considering the vast amount of information people receive every day, I think recipients should pay close attention to the reliability of sources and the accuracy of the content. Verifying information, checking multiple sources, and avoiding emotional reactions to unconfirmed news are essential skills in today’s information-rich society.

sp4-22.title: Đề 22
sp4-22.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-22.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time you received a gift from someone?
CÂU HỎI: How do you feel when you receive a gift?
CÂU HỎI: A handmade present is better than a present bought from a shop. What do you think?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Hello, my name is Anna Mai. When I think about the gifts I’ve received, one that stands out the most is a book titled “That Boy Emil!” by the Swedish author Astrid Lindgren.
This meaningful gift was given to me by Mr. Hai, a mature student in my Aptis ESOL class. He had been working very hard to achieve a B2 level in English, even though he hadn’t used the language for a long time. During his preparation, I supported him by sharing study materials, advising him on the exam schedule, and encouraging him whenever he felt discouraged. After he successfully passed the exam, he gave me this book as a way of expressing his gratitude. When I opened it, I was immediately attracted to the story. Although it is a children’s book, I found the character Emil creative, brave, and playful, and it reminded me of my own childhood. This made the gift even more special to me.
Whenever I receive a gift, I usually feel happy and appreciated, not because of its value, but because it represents a connection between me and the giver. I often try to understand the story or intention behind the gift, as it shows how much thought the person has put into it.
Regarding the final question, I agree that handmade presents can sometimes be more meaningful than gifts bought from a shop. Handmade gifts usually require time, effort, and creativity, which makes them unique and personal. However, I believe the most important thing is the intention behind the gift. Whether it is handmade or purchased, a gift given with sincerity and care will always be valuable.

sp4-23.title: Đề 23
sp4-23.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-23.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you were busy.
CÂU HỎI: How do you feel when you are very busy?
CÂU HỎI: If people worked less, do you think their life will be better?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Now I’m going to talk about a time in my life when I was extremely busy. This happened last summer, when I was responsible for organizing a college competition in Hanoi. During that week, I was occupied from early morning until late at night, and I barely had any time to rest.
Organizing such an event was far from easy. At first, my task was to make a detailed plan and form a team to support me. Unfortunately, I couldn’t find enough suitable people to help, so I ended up handling most of the work on my own. Although a few classmates offered limited assistance, I still had to manage almost every aspect of the event. I had to take care of scheduling, contacting guests and participants, preparing prizes, and arranging the venue inside the college campus. Many nights, I slept very little because I was constantly reviewing plans and solving unexpected problems. At one point, I felt completely exhausted and even considered giving up, as the pressure was overwhelming.
However, I kept reminding myself of my responsibility and stayed determined. In the end, the competition was successfully completed. Despite some minor coordination issues, the event received positive feedback, and I was later praised and awarded for my efforts. Looking back, it was one of the most stressful yet rewarding weeks of my life.
When I am very busy, I usually feel a mixture of stress and motivation. While the workload can be tiring, it also gives me a sense of purpose and pushes me to manage my time more effectively.
Regarding the final question, I believe that if people worked less, their lives could be better, but only to a certain extent. Working fewer hours may reduce stress and allow more time for rest, family, and personal interests. However, being busy can also be meaningful, especially when the work is purposeful and rewarding. In my opinion, the key is finding a healthy balance between work and personal life.

sp4-24.title: Đề 24
sp4-24.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-24.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about somewhere you have traveled?
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: What is the importance of understanding the customs where you travel?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: I’d like to share a memorable travel experience I had in Mù Cang Chải, a mountainous area in northern Vietnam. It was a trip that left a deep impression on me.
After a six-hour journey from Hanoi, my friends and I arrived at Khau Phạ Pass, one of the most famous mountain passes in the region. From there, we could see paragliders gliding above the breathtaking golden terraced rice fields, which created a truly spectacular view. Later, we visited Móng Ngựa, a place well known for its stunning rice terraces glowing under the warm light of the setting sun.
As night fell and the temperature dropped, we stayed at a small homestay next to a flowing stream. We enjoyed a simple local meal, sat by the fire, and shared stories while singing together. The peaceful atmosphere, combined with the majestic mountain scenery and the genuine hospitality of the local people, made me feel relaxed and grateful. Overall, the trip made me feel fortunate to witness such natural beauty and temporarily escape from the fast pace of daily life.
Regarding the final question, I believe understanding local customs is extremely important when traveling. It shows respect for the culture and traditions of the place you visit and helps avoid misunderstandings or uncomfortable situations. Moreover, when travelers are aware of local customs, they can connect more deeply with the community and enjoy a more meaningful and authentic travel experience.

sp4-25.title: Đề 25
sp4-25.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-25.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you wanted something but couldn't have it.
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel about it?
CÂU HỎI: Material possessions can't bring happiness. What are your thoughts on this?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: I recall a situation where I had a strong desire for something, yet I had to accept that it was beyond my reach at the time.
A few years ago, I really wanted to buy a brand-new iPhone 14 Pro Max. It was the latest model, with advanced features and a very attractive design, and many people around me were using it. I had been dreaming of owning one for quite a long time. However, at that point, my financial situation wasn’t stable enough, and I had to prioritize more essential expenses such as living costs and personal development. As a result, I couldn’t afford to buy it. At first, I felt quite disappointed and frustrated. Seeing others enjoy something I wanted made me feel left out, and I kept thinking about what I was missing. However, after some time, I began to reflect on the situation more calmly. I realized that this feeling was temporary and that not getting what I wanted didn’t really affect my life in the long run.
In my opinion, material possessions cannot bring true happiness. Although buying new things can make us feel excited for a short time, that feeling usually fades quickly. Real happiness comes from meaningful experiences, strong relationships, and personal growth. Looking back, I believe that learning to control my desires and focus on long-term goals has helped me become more mature and content with my life.

sp4-26.title: Đề 26
sp4-26.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-26.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you had to make a great effort to achieve something.
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel during and after that experience?
CÂU HỎI: In your opinion, why is making an effort important for success in life?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: In my life, I have encountered several situations where I had to put in a great deal of effort to achieve something meaningful. However, the experience I would like to talk about today left the strongest impression on me.
This happened about four months ago, when a close friend of mine and I were assigned to prepare a presentation for our final exam at university. At first, our topic was related to environmental issues, and we spent weeks researching materials at the library, reading foreign documents, and discussing ideas with other students to improve our content.
However, during the final week of the semester, our instructor suddenly changed the topic and asked us to focus on traffic problems instead. This came as a real shock because we had already invested so much time and effort in the original topic, and there were only two weeks left before the presentation. Despite feeling stressed and discouraged, we decided to follow our teacher’s instructions and start over. We had to redo almost everything, including researching new materials, revising our slides, and asking other students for support. There were several nights when I barely slept because I was determined to finish everything on time. Eventually, all our hard work paid off. We completed the presentation before the deadline and received the highest score from our instructor.
Looking back, I felt extremely proud and satisfied with what we had achieved. In my opinion, making an effort is essential for success in life because it helps us build resilience, discipline, and confidence. Even when situations become challenging or unexpected, effort teaches us how to adapt and push through difficulties. This experience truly taught me the value of perseverance, and it is something I will always remember.

sp4-27.title: Đề 27
sp4-27.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-27.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time someone treated you bad (impolitely)
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: How can people deal with such situations?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Hello, my name is Anna Mai. Thinking about this topic reminds me of a difficult experience I once had when I was treated quite impolitely, and I’d like to share that experience with you.
This happened a few months ago when I was working in a customer service role. One day, a customer contacted me with a very complicated problem and seemed frustrated even before I had a chance to speak. While I was trying to explain the situation calmly and clearly, they kept interrupting me and speaking in a rude and dismissive tone. They didn’t allow me to finish my sentences or fully address their concerns, which made the interaction very challenging. During that moment, I felt stressed, upset, and somewhat discouraged. It was unpleasant to be treated disrespectfully, especially when I was genuinely trying to help. However, I reminded myself to stay professional and not let my emotions take control. I took a deep breath, remained polite, and continued to assist them as best as I could.
In my opinion, when people face such situations, the most important thing is to stay calm and not take the behavior personally. Being patient and showing empathy can sometimes help reduce tension. If the person continues to behave badly, it’s reasonable to politely but firmly set boundaries, for example by asking them to allow you to speak so you can help effectively. Additionally, if the situation becomes too difficult to handle, seeking support from a supervisor or a third party is a sensible solution. Overall, handling impolite behavior with professionalism not only protects our dignity but also helps prevent the situation from becoming worse.

sp4-28.title: Đề 28
sp4-28.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.
sp4-28.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time when you were in a hurry?
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel?
CÂU HỎI: Modern life makes us busier and more rushed. What do you think?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
BÀI MẪU: Hello, I’m Anna Mai. Thinking about this topic reminds me of a time when I was under a lot of pressure and had to rush to finish an important task, and I’d like to share that experience with you.
This happened about four months ago during my final exams at university. At that time, my friend and I were assigned to prepare a presentation about environmental issues. We had already spent weeks researching the topic, working together with classmates, and collecting useful materials from books and online sources. However, in the final week of the semester, our instructor suddenly changed the topic and asked us to focus on traffic problems instead. This unexpected change put us in a very difficult situation because we had only one week left to prepare everything from scratch. As a result, we had to work extremely fast. We revised our research, redesigned all the presentation slides, and even asked other classmates for help. There were several nights when I slept very little, as we worked continuously to meet the deadline.
During that time, I felt extremely stressed and exhausted, but at the same time, I was also determined not to give up. Fortunately, our efforts paid off. We managed to finish the presentation on time and received full marks from our instructor. Looking back, I feel proud and satisfied because the experience taught me how to stay calm and focused under pressure.
Regarding the final question, I strongly agree that modern life makes people busier and more rushed. With the rapid development of technology, work demands, and social responsibilities, many people feel they are constantly racing against time. This lifestyle can easily lead to stress and burnout. However, I believe that modern life also offers tools and opportunities to manage time more efficiently. If people learn how to prioritize tasks and maintain a healthy work-life balance, they can reduce stress and live more comfortably despite the fast pace of life.

wc-beautiful-homes-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-beautiful-homes-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-beautiful-homes-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Why do you want to join Beautiful Homes club?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I want to join this club to learn how to decorate my home. I am interested because a beautiful home reduces my stress. For example, plants make my room peaceful.

wc-beautiful-homes-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-beautiful-homes-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-beautiful-homes-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: I have a bad relationship with my neighbors because they often make noise. Tell me how is your relationship with your neighbors?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I have a wonderful relationship with my neighbours. I like them because they are friendly and always keep quiet at night. For example, they often share fruit from their garden with my family.

CÂU HỎI: Do you prefer living in old buildings or modern buildings? Why?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I prefer living in modern buildings rather than old ones. I choose them because I am busy with work and study. For example, modern flats have lifts and repairs are quick and easy.

CÂU HỎI: The house should be designed in a way that is good for the environment. Do you agree?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I completely agree that homes should be eco-friendly. I think so because natural light and wind help us save money on electricity. I also believe green spaces are good for our health.

wc-beautiful-homes-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-beautiful-homes-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-beautiful-homes-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the plan to knock down old buildings
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Miha,
I'm really worried about the plan to knock down the old buildings.
I think it would be great to keep them because they are beautiful and historic.
I'm considering suggesting repairing them instead of destroying them.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about the plan to knock down old buildings
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the plan to knock down the old buildings in our area. I am rather concerned about this proposal, as these buildings have great historical and cultural value.
I would like to suggest upgrading the old buildings instead of destroying them. I believe this is the best option because modern technology can repair them safely while keeping their original character. However, new apartment blocks might also increase housing prices, which would be very difficult for students and young families.
If repairing every building is not possible, we could at least protect the most important ones and build new blocks only in empty areas. I also suggest holding a public meeting so that local residents can share their opinions before any decision is made.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Anh Hao
