wc-book-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-book-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-book-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: When and where do you like reading books?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I usually read books on Sunday mornings at a quiet local café. I like reading there because the relaxing atmosphere helps me focus on the story. I also enjoy a cup of coffee while I read.

CÂU HỎI: I would like to give my friend a book. What would you suggest?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I would suggest giving your friend a funny novel. I recommend it because it is entertaining and helps people relax after a long day. For example, books by Nguyen Nhat Anh are popular with all ages.

CÂU HỎI: Will online books replace traditional books? What do you think?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I don't think online books will completely replace traditional books. I believe this because paper books give readers a special feeling. I also think reading on paper is better for our eyes than looking at screens.

wc-book-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-book-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-book-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the club stopping free monthly books & delivery delays
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Sam,
I'm quite disappointed that the club will stop sending free monthly books.
I think waiting four to six weeks for delivery is also far too long.
I'm considering suggesting free e-books instead.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about stopping free books & delivery delays
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the recent changes to our book club. I am rather disappointed about the decision to stop the free monthly books, as many members joined partly for this benefit.
I would like to suggest replacing the printed book with a free monthly e-book. I believe this would save the club money because e-books cost much less and need no delivery. However, waiting four to six weeks for printed orders is simply too long for most readers.
If free e-books are unavailable, we could offer members a discount on every book they order instead. I also suggest working with a faster delivery company and providing online order tracking, so that members can plan their reading more easily.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the local library possibly closing down
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Miha,
I'm really worried about the news that our local library might close.
I think it would be great to keep it open because many students and older people still use it.
I'm considering suggesting community events to attract more readers.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about the local library possibly closing down
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the possible closure of our local library. I am very concerned about this plan, as the library is still an important place for our community.
I would like to suggest organising more community events instead of closing it. I believe this would bring visitors back because weekend book clubs and storytelling sessions are popular with families. However, I understand that the library is expensive to run and fewer young people visit it nowadays.
If the library cannot stay open every day, we could reduce its opening hours rather than close it completely. I also suggest offering a free digital lending service, so that modern readers can borrow e-books while older residents can still enjoy a quiet place to read.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Anh Hao

wc-car-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-car-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-car-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: When was the last time you were in a car?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: The last time I was in a car was yesterday morning. I booked a taxi because it was raining heavily. For example, the roads were flooded near my house.

wc-car-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-car-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-car-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: I have just moved to this city. Should I buy a car or use public transportation?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Welcome! I recommend using public transport first instead of buying a car. I suggest this because buses here are cheap and convenient. I also think driving can be stressful because the streets are often crowded.

CÂU HỎI: Tell me a time you travelled by car.
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Last summer, my family travelled by car to a beautiful beach. I enjoyed the trip because we could stop whenever we wanted. For example, we had lunch at a small seafood restaurant on the way.

CÂU HỎI: Some people believe that there should be a policy applied to cars to solve the transportation problem. What is your opinion?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I strongly agree that we need a policy for cars in cities. I believe this because traffic jams and air pollution are serious problems. For example, cities could limit private cars during rush hours.

wc-car-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-car-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-car-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the European car program (main driver or passenger?)
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Miha,
I'm really excited about the club's European car programme.
I think it would be great to apply as a passenger rather than the main driver.
I'm considering it because I'm good at reading maps and want to enjoy the scenery.
What about you?
Talk soon,
Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about your chosen position in the European car program
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the club's European car programme. I am very excited about this event, and I would like to apply for the passenger position.
I would like to suggest that I support the main driver as the navigator. I believe I am suitable for this role because I am excellent at reading maps and planning routes on unfamiliar roads. However, I understand that the club also needs experienced drivers, and I do have a full driving licence.
If the passenger position is unavailable, we could arrange for me to share the driving with another member on long journeys. I also suggest holding a short planning meeting before the trip, so that every team can agree on routes, rest stops and safety rules.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Anh Hao

wc-community-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-community-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-community-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Why did you join this Community club?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I joined this club to help my local community. I chose it because I want to do meaningful work. Also, I hope to meet new people and improve my teamwork.

CÂU HỎI: Describe where you live.
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I live in a modern apartment in the city centre. I like it because it is very convenient. For example, the bus stop and supermarket are just five minutes away.

wc-community-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-community-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-community-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: My friend wants to go to the hair salon, but her car isn't working. Can you suggest some ways for her to get there?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I think your friend should take a taxi to the hair salon. I suggest this because it is fast and convenient. I also think a bus is a good choice because it is much cheaper for a short trip.

CÂU HỎI: Volunteering provides great learning opportunities and helps others a lot. Do you agree?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I totally agree that volunteering is very valuable. I believe this because we learn useful skills while helping others. For example, volunteers often improve their communication and teamwork through community projects.

CÂU HỎI: Do you agree that volunteering is a form of learning, especially for young people? Why?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I completely agree that volunteering is a form of learning. I think so because young people gain real-life experience. For example, they learn to solve problems and work with people from different backgrounds.

CÂU HỎI: What do you usually do to help people around you?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I usually help children in my neighbourhood with their homework. I do this because many families cannot afford extra classes. For example, I teach two students English every Saturday morning, and they have become more confident.

CÂU HỎI: I really like charity activities but don't know how, can you give me some advice?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I suggest joining a local charity group first. I recommend this because they always need volunteers and can guide you. For example, you could help clean a park or visit an animal shelter at the weekend.

CÂU HỎI: Should teenagers volunteer during school holidays?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I think teenagers should volunteer during school holidays. I believe this because it helps them develop soft skills like teamwork. I also think it makes them more responsible and caring towards others.

wc-community-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-community-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-community-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend: sports facilities vs parks for the elderly - which project should the club choose?
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Chloe,
I'm really excited about the club's two new community projects.
I think it would be great to choose the sports facilities, because they help young people stay active.
I'm considering sending my opinion to the manager soon.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Van

CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about supporting the club's projects this year
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm really excited about the Community Club's new projects this year.
I think it would be great to support them because they are meaningful for our area.
I'm considering sending the manager some ideas, such as a recruitment event.
What do you think?
Hugs,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager with suggestions to support projects
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about how members can support the club's projects this year. I am very pleased that the club is planning so many meaningful activities for the community.
I would like to suggest organising a membership recruitment event. I believe this would attract more volunteers because local people often want to help but do not know how to join. However, the club may not have enough money to hire a large venue or invite performers.
If a large venue is unavailable, we could hold the event in a local park and invite members who can sing or play music. I also suggest creating an online voting system, so that members can share creative ideas for new activities and choose the best ones together.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Quoc Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager: which community project should be prioritized?
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the two community projects mentioned in the recent announcement. I am very pleased that the club wants to improve our neighbourhood for different age groups.
I would like to suggest prioritising the sports facilities for children and young people. I believe this project would bring long-term benefits because it encourages teenagers to exercise and spend less time on their phones. However, I understand that parks for elderly people are also important and meaningful.
If the club cannot fund both projects this year, we could build the sports facilities first and design part of the area as a quiet garden for older residents. I also suggest asking local businesses to sponsor the projects, so that the second one can start next year.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Thao Van Truong

wc-english-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-english-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-english-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: What do you usually use the internet for?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I mainly use the internet for study and entertainment. I use it a lot because it is fast and convenient. For example, I search for documents and watch videos.

wc-english-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-english-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-english-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: How do you learn English?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I learn English at a small centre near my university four times a week. I study there because the teachers are friendly and helpful. I also practise by listening to English songs and watching films.

CÂU HỎI: English is a popular language in the world. What are your thoughts on this idea?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I agree that English is a very important global language. I think so because people from many countries use it to communicate. For example, most international businesses use English in meetings and emails.

CÂU HỎI: When do you usually use English?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I usually use English at work and when I travel. I need it because I often write emails to foreign clients. For example, last month I used English to help a tourist find the train station.

CÂU HỎI: How do you feel about the club meeting this afternoon?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I found this afternoon's club meeting very interesting and useful. I enjoyed it because I met many new members. I also liked sharing ideas about future club activities and how to improve the club.

CÂU HỎI: What topic are you expecting us to talk about next meeting?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I hope we can talk about new words in everyday English next time. I suggest this topic because it is interesting and quite controversial. I also think members will enjoy sharing different opinions about it.

CÂU HỎI: We are thinking of holding some English games next week. Can you suggest some?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I suggest organising some English music games next week. I think they are a good idea because music helps people learn naturally. I also recommend tongue twisters to improve members' pronunciation in a fun way.

wc-english-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-english-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-english-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about new words being added to the language
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm really excited about the club's discussion on new words in English.
I think it would be great to learn modern expressions, but we should use them carefully.
I'm considering sending the manager my opinion about this topic.
What do you think?
Hugs,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about new words in modern language
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the increasing number of new words in modern English. I am very pleased that the club has chosen this interesting topic for discussion.
I would like to suggest organising a session where members learn and discuss new words together. I believe this would be useful because language is always changing, and modern expressions help us communicate naturally. However, using too many new words may make communication difficult, especially for older people.
If a full session is not possible, we could share a list of new words with clear examples in the club newsletter every month. I also suggest inviting a teacher to explain when these words are appropriate, so that members can use them correctly in different situations.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the talk show being canceled
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm quite disappointed that the club's talk show has been cancelled.
I think it would be great to have another activity on that day instead.
I'm considering suggesting English games or a music competition.
What do you think?
Hugs,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club president about the canceled talk show
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the cancellation of the talk show. I am rather disappointed about this news, as many members were really looking forward to the event.
I would like to suggest organising another activity on the same day instead of cancelling the meeting completely. I believe English board games or a music competition would be a good choice because they help members practise English in a relaxed way. However, there may not be enough time to prepare a large event.
If a new activity cannot be prepared in time, we could move the talk show to a later date when the guest is available. I also suggest sending all members an email as soon as possible, so that everyone knows about the new plan.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Quoc Anh

wc-fashion-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-fashion-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.

Talk soon,

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about the designer meeting organization
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the designer meetings described in your recent email. I am very pleased about this plan, as it is a great chance for members to learn from professionals.
I would like to suggest organising the meetings as a fashion show-style event. I believe this would be more enjoyable because members can see the designs in person and talk to the designers directly. However, an online meeting may be easier to arrange, but many members already spend too much time looking at screens.
If a fashion show is unavailable, we could hold a small workshop in the club room where designers bring a few pieces to display. I also suggest recording the event, so that members who cannot attend can still watch it later.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Anh Hao

wc-film-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-film-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-film-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Please write some of your favourite films and why you like watching them.
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: My favourite film is Inception. I like it because the story is clever and exciting. For example, it makes me think about the difference between dreams and reality.

wc-film-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-film-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-film-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: Hi! Welcome to the club. How often do you watch films?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Thanks for the welcome. I usually watch films twice a week, especially at weekends. I enjoy them because they help me relax after a busy week. For example, last Saturday I watched a comedy with my family.

CÂU HỎI: Can you remember the first film you watched? What was it like?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, the first film I remember watching was Finding Nemo. I loved it because it was funny and touching at the same time. I also learned a lot about courage and family from the story.

CÂU HỎI: What would you like to learn from the film club?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I would love to improve my English listening skills in the film club. I want this because I often watch films without subtitles. I also hope to learn how films show social issues in different countries.

wc-film-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-film-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-film-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the club inviting a reviewer for next year's film
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Lan,
I'm really excited about the club's plan to invite a film reviewer next year.
I think it would be great to have someone who appeals to all ages.
I'm considering suggesting Victor Vu because he is very experienced.
What do you think?
Hugs,
Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager suggesting a film reviewer
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about your plan to invite a reviewer for a popular film next year. I am very excited about this opportunity, as it could make the club more interesting for members of all ages.
I would like to suggest inviting Victor Vu. I believe he would be ideal because he has many years of experience in the film industry and makes films that both younger and older audiences enjoy. However, he is very busy and may not be able to visit our club.
If he is unavailable, we could invite another experienced critic who explains films in a simple and interesting way. I also suggest giving members early tickets, so that they can watch the film and prepare questions for the reviewer.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Hao

wc-fitness-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-fitness-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-fitness-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Please talk about the last time you had to run somewhere?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: The last time I had to run was yesterday morning. I ran because I woke up late. For example, I nearly missed the bus to my university class.

wc-fitness-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-fitness-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-fitness-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: I often go jogging because it is good for my health. What about you?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I prefer playing badminton to jogging. I enjoy it because I can play with my friends at a local park. I also find that it helps me reduce stress after a long day of work and study.

CÂU HỎI: I want to start exercising but I am very busy. What is your advice?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I suggest doing short exercises at home every morning. I recommend this because it only takes fifteen minutes. I also think you could walk or cycle to work, which is an easy way to stay active.

CÂU HỎI: Nowadays, technology makes people's lives easier, but it also makes them lazy and dislike exercise. Do you agree with this opinion?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I completely agree with this opinion. I think so because people spend too much time sitting in front of computers and phones. For example, many young people prefer online games to playing sports outside.

wc-fitness-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-fitness-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-fitness-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the club's plan (sponsorship event vs 50% fee increase)
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Miha,
I'm really excited that the club wants to buy new equipment.
I think it would be great to hold a sponsorship event to raise the money.
I'm considering opposing the 50% fee increase because it's too expensive for students.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about the equipment upgrade plan
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the plan to upgrade our sports equipment. I am very pleased that the club wants to improve its facilities, but I have some concerns about how to raise the money.
I would like to suggest holding a sponsorship event. I believe this is the best option because it brings members together and helps the club connect with local businesses. However, increasing the membership fee by 50% is too expensive, especially for students on a tight budget, and some members might leave.
If a sponsorship event is not possible, we could raise the fee by a smaller amount and offer discounts for students. I also suggest buying the equipment in stages, so that the most important machines arrive first.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Anh Hao

wc-home-living-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-home-living-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-home-living-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe where you live?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I live in a small house near the city centre. I like it because it is comfortable. Also, I live there with my two younger brothers, which is fun.

wc-home-living-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-home-living-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-home-living-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: You have to share the bedroom with your brother. How do you feel?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I feel quite comfortable sharing a bedroom with my brother. I like it because we can talk and help each other every day. I also think living together has made us closer than ever before.

CÂU HỎI: It is better to live in the city than in the countryside. Do you agree? Why?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I agree that living in the city is better than the countryside. I think so because there are more job opportunities. I also believe hospitals, schools and public transport are much better in cities.

CÂU HỎI: Old buildings are demolished and replaced with modern buildings. Should we protect historic buildings?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I think we should protect historic buildings. I believe this because they are part of a city's history and culture. However, buildings that are unsafe should be repaired or replaced with safer ones.

wc-home-living-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-home-living-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-home-living-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about helping young families find homes
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm really excited about the club's new topic: helping young families find homes.
I think it would be great to share practical advice about price and location.
I'm considering sending the manager some suggestions.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager with suggestions to help young families find homes
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about how the club can help young families find suitable homes. I am very pleased that the club has chosen this topic, as many young couples are struggling with housing nowadays.
I would like to suggest running a monthly workshop on choosing a first home. I believe this would be very useful because young families often borrow too much money and forget about location and safety. However, it may be difficult to find experts who can attend regularly.
If experts are unavailable, we could ask experienced members to share their own stories of buying or renting a home. I also suggest creating a simple checklist covering price, distance to schools and hospitals, and the quality of the neighbourhood, so that families can compare homes easily.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Quoc Anh

wc-language-club-p1.title: Trả lời tin nhắn ngắn
wc-language-club-p1.instr: Trả lời mỗi tin nhắn bằng 1–5 từ. Nên xong trong khoảng 3 phút.
wc-language-club-p1.body:
CÂU HỎI: Where are you from?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I come from Vietnam.

CÂU HỎI: What's the weather like today?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: It is raining heavily today. / It is quite hot and sunny today.

CÂU HỎI: What do you do in your free time?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I usually listen to music.

CÂU HỎI: What is your first language?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: My mother tongue is Vietnamese.

CÂU HỎI: Who do you usually go to the movies with?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I normally go with my girlfriend.

CÂU HỎI: What food do you like?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I am really fond of Thai food because it is spicy and flavorful.

CÂU HỎI: How often do you go for a walk?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I usually go for a walk in the park every evening after work.

CÂU HỎI: What do you do in the evening?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: In the evening, I often read books or listen to music to relax.

CÂU HỎI: Where are you going to tomorrow?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Tomorrow, I am going to attend a training workshop with my colleagues.

wc-language-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-language-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-language-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me your free time and interests?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: In my free time, I usually play football with friends. I enjoy it because it keeps me healthy. Also, I like listening to music to relax after work.

CÂU HỎI: In which cases do you often use foreign languages?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I mainly use English at work. I need it because I communicate with international clients. For example, I write emails and join online meetings in English every week.

CÂU HỎI: Where do you usually study and why?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I usually study at a quiet coffee shop near my apartment. I go there because the atmosphere is peaceful. For example, I can focus for hours without any distractions.

wc-language-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-language-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-language-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: Why did you choose this course?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I chose this course to improve my English communication skills. I need them because I use English in meetings at work. I also hope it will help me find better job opportunities in the future.

CÂU HỎI: How have you found the course so far? What's been difficult?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! So far, I have really enjoyed the course. I like it because the lessons are interesting and easy to follow. However, listening is still difficult for me because native speakers often talk very quickly.

CÂU HỎI: What are you hoping to do when you finish the course?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! After the course, I hope to use English more naturally at work and when I travel. I want this because it will make me more confident. I also plan to take an English certificate to improve my CV.

CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a memory you have with a foreign language?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I still remember the first time I spoke English with a foreign customer. I was nervous because my English was not perfect. However, the customer was very friendly, and I felt much more confident afterwards.

CÂU HỎI: I am very forgetful. Can you give me tips to remember new words?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I suggest using each new word in a sentence straight away. I recommend this because using words helps you remember them longer. For example, you can write three sentences with new words every evening.

CÂU HỎI: What do you think is the most effective way to learn English?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I think the most effective way is to practise a little every day. I believe this because regular practice is better than studying a lot at once. For example, you can watch short videos and speak with friends daily.

CÂU HỎI: Do you remember anything about foreign language classes in school?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I remember my English classes at high school very clearly. I enjoyed them because my teacher organised fun group discussions. I also became more confident in speaking thanks to those interesting activities.

CÂU HỎI: Why is learning a new language important?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I think learning a new language is very important. I believe this because it helps us communicate with people from different cultures. I also think it creates better study and career opportunities in today's world.

wc-language-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-language-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-language-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about new features for the club website
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm really excited about the new features planned for the club website.
I think it would be great to add online chat rooms and vocabulary games.
I'm considering sending these ideas to the manager this week.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend recommending the English course you're taking
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm really pleased with the English course I'm taking at American Dream Center.
I think it would be great for you too, because my speaking has improved a lot.
I'm considering asking if we could join a class together.
What do you think?
Hugs,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager explaining why you can't continue the course
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about my English course at A Level Speaking Center. I am very pleased with the lessons, but I am sorry to say that I cannot continue for the next few weeks.
I would like to suggest pausing my course temporarily. I believe this is the best solution because I have just started a new full-time job and my schedule is very busy at the moment. However, I do not want to lose my place, as the teachers have been very supportive.
If pausing the course is not possible, we could move me to an evening or weekend class that fits my working hours. I also suggest sending me the lesson materials online, so that I can keep studying at home until I return.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Quoc Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about applying to be a guest speaker
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm really excited that the club is looking for a guest speaker.
I think it would be great to talk about practical ways to improve English.
I'm considering applying for the role this week.
Do you think it's a good idea?
Talk soon,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club expressing your desire to be a guest speaker
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the club's search for a speaker for the upcoming lecture. I am very excited about this event, and I would like to apply to be the speaker.
I would like to suggest a talk on how to use English effectively in daily life and at work. I believe I am suitable for this role because I have given similar presentations many times and I enjoy sharing practical tips. However, I understand that other members may also want to apply.
If the main lecture is unavailable, we could organise a shorter workshop where I share my ideas with a smaller group. I also suggest including a question-and-answer session at the end, so that members can ask about their own learning problems.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Quoc Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about new website features
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the new features planned for the club website. I am very pleased that the club wants to make the website more useful for its members.
I would like to suggest adding online discussion rooms where members can practise speaking together. I believe this would be very effective because learners need regular practice with real people to become confident. However, discussion rooms need someone to manage them, which may take a lot of time.
If a full-time moderator is unavailable, we could ask experienced members to take turns managing the rooms each week. I also suggest adding vocabulary quizzes and daily reminders, so that members are encouraged to study a little every day.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Thao Van Truong

wc-music-club-p1.title: Trả lời tin nhắn ngắn
wc-music-club-p1.instr: Trả lời mỗi tin nhắn bằng 1–5 từ. Nên xong trong khoảng 3 phút.
wc-music-club-p1.body:
CÂU HỎI: How many people in your family?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I have four people in my family.

CÂU HỎI: What is your hobby?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: My hobby is gardening and reading.

CÂU HỎI: What did you do last night?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Last night, I watched a movie and relaxed at home.

CÂU HỎI: How do you go to work?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I go to work by driving my motorbike.

CÂU HỎI: What kind of music do you like?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I like listening to classical music and rap.

wc-music-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-music-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-music-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: When and where do you listen to music?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I usually listen to music in my room when I feel stressed. I do this because music helps me relax. For example, I play soft songs after studying.

wc-music-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-music-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-music-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: What do you think about music?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi everyone! I really love music, especially pop songs. I listen to it every day because it helps me relax and feel happy. For example, I often play music at night after studying or when I feel stressed.

wc-music-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-music-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-music-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the club's music event for all ages
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Minh,
I'm really excited about the club's idea of music events for all ages.
I think it would be great to include live performances and dance sessions.
I'm considering suggesting different music styles so everyone can enjoy it.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about the music event
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the club's plan to organise music events for people of all ages. I am very pleased about this idea, as music is a wonderful way to bring different generations together.
I would like to suggest including performances in several music styles. I believe this would attract a wider audience because young people and older people usually enjoy different kinds of music. However, it may be difficult to find enough performers for every style.
If professional performers are unavailable, we could invite talented members and local students to perform. I also suggest organising family activities such as dance sessions and music quizzes, so that parents, children and grandparents can take part together.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Hao

wc-photography-club-p1.title: Trả lời tin nhắn ngắn
wc-photography-club-p1.instr: Trả lời mỗi tin nhắn bằng 1–5 từ. Nên xong trong khoảng 3 phút.
wc-photography-club-p1.body:
CÂU HỎI: Where are you from?

BÀI MẪU: I come from Vietnam.

CÂU HỎI: What's the weather like today?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: It is raining heavily today.

CÂU HỎI: What do you do in your free time?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I often chat with my friends.

CÂU HỎI: What is your first language?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Vietnamese is my first language.

CÂU HỎI: Who do you usually go to the movies with?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: I normally go with my girlfriend.

wc-photography-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-photography-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-photography-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Please tell me the last time you took a picture?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: The last time I took a picture was during a trip to Da Nang. I took many photos because the beaches were beautiful. Also, I wanted to keep memories.

wc-photography-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-photography-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-photography-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: How to have a beautiful picture?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I think good timing is the key to a beautiful picture. I believe this because the right moment makes a photo meaningful. I also think you should pay attention to light and composition before taking a photo.

CÂU HỎI: How do you save your photos?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I usually save my photos on Google Drive and on my phone. I do this because I can see my pictures anytime. I also avoid losing important photos if my phone is broken or stolen.

CÂU HỎI: What skills do you need to take good photos?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I think creativity is the most important skill for taking good photos. I believe this because creative people find unusual ideas. I also think communication skills help photographers make people feel comfortable in front of the camera.

wc-photography-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-photography-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-photography-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the photo exhibition idea
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ngan,
I'm really excited about the club's photo exhibition.
I think it would be great to show photos that people of all ages can enjoy.
I'm considering sending the manager some ideas about the timing and themes.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about the photo exhibition
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the upcoming photography exhibition. I am very pleased about this event, as it gives members a great chance to show their best work.
I would like to suggest holding the exhibition at the weekend. I believe this would attract more visitors because most students and working people are free on Saturdays and Sundays. However, the club room may be too small for a large number of visitors.
If a bigger venue is unavailable, we could display some of the photos online so that more people can see them. I also suggest including different themes such as nature, family and daily life, and preparing small souvenirs, so that visitors of all ages enjoy the exhibition.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Quoc Anh

wc-social-club-p1.title: Trả lời tin nhắn ngắn
wc-social-club-p1.instr: Trả lời mỗi tin nhắn bằng 1–5 từ. Nên xong trong khoảng 3 phút.
wc-social-club-p1.body:
CÂU HỎI: What's the weather like today?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Mẫu 1: The weather today is sunny and warm, which makes me feel relaxed.
Mẫu 2: It is sunny today.

CÂU HỎI: How are you?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Mẫu 1: I am doing well today, thank you for asking.
Mẫu 2: I am fine, thank you.

CÂU HỎI: What's your hobby?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Mẫu 1: I enjoy reading books and hiking in nature in my free time.
Mẫu 2: I enjoy listening to music.

CÂU HỎI: How do you get to work?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Mẫu 1: I get to work by driving my bike because it is more convenient for me.
Mẫu 2: I usually walk to work.

CÂU HỎI: What do you like to do in the evening?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Mẫu 1: In the evening, I usually relax by reading a good book or listening to music.
Mẫu 2: I like listening to music.

wc-social-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-social-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-social-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: What do you like to do with friends and where do you go?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I enjoy going out for coffee with my friends. I like it because we can talk and relax together. For example, we often visit a cosy café on Sundays.

wc-social-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-social-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-social-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: Where did you meet your friends for the first time and how did you become friends?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I first met my best friends in an English class two years ago. We became close because we did a group project together. After that, we started meeting outside class for coffee and long conversations.

CÂU HỎI: I have just moved to the city and want to make some friends. Can you give me some advice?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Welcome to the city! I suggest joining a local club or social group. I recommend this because it is the easiest way to meet people. For example, you could join a sports team or a book club at weekends.

CÂU HỎI: Some people say we should share our hobbies with our friends, do you agree with this and why?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I totally agree that we should share our hobbies with friends. I think so because it makes friendships stronger and more fun. For example, my friends and I play badminton together every weekend.

CÂU HỎI: It is much easier to make new friends these days because of computers and mobile phones. Do you agree? Why or why not?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I don't really agree with this idea. I think so because people now chat online instead of meeting face to face. I also believe real friendships need time together, not just messages on a phone.

wc-social-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-social-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wc-social-club-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the club's online/offline event idea
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi John,
I'm really excited about the club's idea of monthly meetings.
I think it would be great to meet in places that are easy to reach by bus.
I'm considering suggesting both weekend and weekday evening meetings.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Viet Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to a friend about the club's monthly face-to-face meeting idea
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Ha,
I'm really excited about the club's plan for face-to-face meetings.
I think it would be great to meet on Sunday mornings because we're busy during the week.
I'm considering suggesting a local café.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Anh Hao

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about the online/offline event idea
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about whether our monthly meetings should be held online or in person. I am very pleased that the club wants members to meet more regularly.
I would like to suggest holding the meetings face to face. I believe this would be more effective because people communicate more naturally and build stronger friendships in person. However, some members live far away or have busy schedules, so they may find it difficult to attend.
If a face-to-face meeting is not possible every month, we could hold an online meeting every second month instead. I also suggest choosing places that are easy to reach by public transport and alternating between weekends and weekday evenings, so that everyone has a chance to join.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Viet Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager about when/where to hold monthly meetings
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about when and where to hold our monthly face-to-face meetings. I am very pleased about this plan, as it is a great chance for members to make new friends.
I would like to suggest meeting on Sunday mornings at a quiet café. I believe this is the best choice because younger members are busy with work and classes during the week, while older members prefer a relaxed morning. However, popular cafés can be crowded at the weekend.
If a café is unavailable, we could use a meeting room at the local community centre. I also suggest booking the venue a month in advance, so that members can plan their schedules and the club can avoid last-minute problems.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Anh Hao

wc-technology-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: What do you usually use your laptop for?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I mainly use my laptop for work and entertainment. I use it every day because it is fast and useful. For example, I write reports and watch films.

wc-technology-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-technology-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wc-technology-club-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: Do you often watch movies on your laptop or go to the theater?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I usually watch films on my laptop rather than at the cinema. I prefer this because I am tired after work and want to relax at home. I also save time and money by watching films online.

CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a bad time with your computer.
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Last month, I had a bad experience with my laptop at work. I was upset because it froze while I was writing an important report. As a result, I lost some files and had to work late.

CÂU HỎI: Technological improvements have made our lives easier. What do you think?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I totally agree that technology has made our lives easier. I think so because we can work and communicate from anywhere. For example, I can join meetings online and send documents to colleagues in just a few seconds.

wc-technology-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-technology-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.

I'm really excited about the club's technology fair.

I'm considering applying for it this week.
Would you like to join me?
Talk soon,
Anh

CÂU HỎI: Write to the club manager applying to volunteer at the technology fair
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the upcoming technology fair. I am very excited about this event, and I would like to apply to become a volunteer.
I would like to suggest that I help at the information desk or with product demonstrations. I believe I am suitable for this role because I have supported several technology events at my company and I enjoy explaining new devices to people. However, I am only available at weekends because of my work schedule.
If weekend shifts are unavailable, we could arrange for me to help with online registration before the fair. I also suggest holding a short training session for all volunteers, so that everyone understands their tasks and the event runs smoothly.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Quoc Anh

wc-television-club-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wc-television-club-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wc-television-club-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: When do you usually watch TV? What do you usually watch?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I usually watch TV in the evening after dinner. I like action films because they are exciting. For example, I often watch Marvel movies with my brother.

wc-television-club-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wc-television-club-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.

CÂU HỎI: I usually eat and sit on a chair while watching TV, what about you?

BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I feel the same way about watching TV with talkative people. I prefer watching alone because I want to focus on the story. I also think talking during a film can be quite annoying for others.

CÂU HỎI: People say it is not good for children to watch too much TV, do you agree?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I totally agree with this opinion. I think so because children who watch too much TV spend less time exercising. For example, they may have health problems such as obesity and poor eyesight.

wc-television-club-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wc-television-club-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.

Anh

I would like to suggest holding the conference in a large hall in the city centre. I believe this would be the most convenient choice because it is easy to reach by public transport and has enough space for everyone. However, renting a large hall in the city centre may be expensive.
If a large hall is unavailable, we could use a university lecture room, which is usually cheaper at the weekend. I also suggest organising group games and a quiz about popular TV programmes, so that members can get to know each other.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Nguyen Anh Hao
