? Gửi tiêu đề bài luận trước thứ Sáu.

Listen to a woman describing her neighbour. What is he like?
W: My neighbour is very quiet – I hardly ever hear him. But whenever I need help, like when my car broke down, he's always the first to offer. He's incredibly kind.
*Helpful
Noisy
Unfriendly
? "he's always the first to offer. He's incredibly kind."

mk7-lp2.title: Ghép người nói
mk7-lp2.instr: Four people are talking about their best holiday. Match each speaker with what made it special. There are two extra options.
mk7-lp2.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Learning something new | Meeting local people | The food | The peace and quiet | The weather | Trying an adventure activity
Speaker A = Trying an adventure activity
M: We spent a week in New Zealand, and the highlight was definitely the bungee jump. I was terrified standing on the bridge, but jumping off was the most exciting thing I've ever done. I'd do it again tomorrow.
Speaker B = The peace and quiet
W: I stayed in a small cabin in the mountains with no internet and no phone signal. At first it felt strange, but after a day or two I started to enjoy the silence. I read, walked and slept better than I had for years.
Speaker C = Meeting local people
M: In Laos, we stayed with a family in a village instead of a hotel. They invited us to their son's wedding, and we danced with everyone until midnight. I'm still in touch with them now.
Speaker D = Learning something new
W: Last summer, I spent two weeks in Italy doing a cooking course. Every morning, we went to the market with a chef and then learned to make pasta and sauces from scratch. Now I cook Italian food for my family every week.

mk7-lp3.audio:
W: Another shop on the high street has closed. That's the third one this year.
M: It's sad, but it's not surprising. Everything's cheaper online.
W: Not always. And when you buy online, you can't touch or try anything.
M: True, I've returned so many clothes that didn't fit.
W: Me too. But what worries me most is that the town centre will become empty.
M: I think the council should lower rents for small shops. That would really help.
W: Good idea. I'd definitely support that.
mk7-lp3.title: Ai có ý kiến này?
mk7-lp3.instr: A man and a woman are discussing online shopping and local shops. Decide whose opinion matches each statement: the man, the woman, or both.
mk7-lp3.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Man | Woman | Both
Online prices are lower. = Man
You can't check products properly online. = Woman
They have had to send back items bought online. = Both
Cheaper rents would help local shops. = Both

mk7-lp4a.audio: W: We've all heard that breakfast is the most important meal of the day. The truth is a bit more complicated. Recent studies suggest that, for healthy adults, skipping breakfast doesn't necessarily lead to weight gain, as people used to believe. What matters far more is what you eat over the whole day. That said, I still recommend breakfast for children and teenagers, because research shows they concentrate better at school after eating in the morning. My main concern is the type of breakfast many people choose. Sugary cereals and pastries give you a quick burst of energy, but you'll be hungry again by ten o'clock.
mk7-lp4a.title: Bài nói 1
mk7-lp4a.instr: Listen to a nutritionist talking about breakfast. Answer two questions.
mk7-lp4a.body:
What does the nutritionist say about the idea that breakfast is the most important meal?
*It is not completely true for adults
It has been proved by research
It is true for everyone
? "for healthy adults, skipping breakfast doesn't necessarily lead to weight gain".

What is she worried about?
*People choosing unhealthy breakfast foods
Children not eating lunch
Adults eating too much at night
? "My main concern is the type of breakfast many people choose."

mk7-lp4b.audio: M: Every year, dozens of historic buildings in our city are knocked down to make room for new apartments and offices. Developers argue that the city needs housing, and I accept that. But once an old building is gone, it's gone forever. What frustrates me is that many of these buildings could be converted rather than destroyed. Old factories make wonderful apartments, and former banks can become restaurants or libraries. In other countries, this approach has attracted tourists and given neighbourhoods a unique character. I'm not saying every old building should be saved, but I'd like to see developers at least consider the option.
mk7-lp4b.title: Bài nói 2
mk7-lp4b.instr: Listen to a historian talking about old buildings in cities. Answer two questions.
mk7-lp4b.body:
What frustrates the historian?
*Buildings are destroyed when they could be reused
Developers build too slowly
The city does not need new housing
? "many of these buildings could be converted rather than destroyed".

What is his overall position?
*Developers should consider keeping old buildings
Every old building must be protected
New buildings are more attractive
? "I'm not saying every old building should be saved, but… at least consider the option."

mk7-w1.title: Trả lời tin nhắn ngắn
mk7-w1.instr: Trả lời mỗi tin nhắn bằng 1–5 từ. Nên xong trong khoảng 3 phút.
mk7-w1.body:
CÂU HỎI: Have you ever climbed a mountain?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Yes, Fansipan last year.

CÂU HỎI: What do you usually wear for hiking?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Trainers and a raincoat.

CÂU HỎI: How do you feel today?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: A bit tired, but happy.

CÂU HỎI: What's your favourite season?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Autumn.

CÂU HỎI: What do you take on a long walk?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Water and some snacks.

mk7-w2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
mk7-w2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
mk7-w2.body:
CÂU HỎI: You are a new member of the Hiking Club. Tell us why you want to join.
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I want to join the club to explore nature with other people. I am interested because hiking keeps me fit. For example, I hike near Ba Vi monthly.

mk7-w3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
mk7-w3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
mk7-w3.body:
NGƯỜI HỎI: Jack
CÂU HỎI: Hi! What is the most beautiful place you have ever hiked?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi Jack! The most beautiful place I have hiked is Ha Giang in the north of Vietnam. I loved it because the mountains and rice terraces were amazing. I also enjoyed meeting friendly local people along the way.

NGƯỜI HỎI: Emily
CÂU HỎI: I'm not very fit. Can I still join the club's hikes? Any advice?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi Emily! Yes, you can definitely join our easier hikes. I think you will enjoy them because they are short and slow. I also suggest walking for thirty minutes every day to build your strength.

NGƯỜI HỎI: David
CÂU HỎI: Some people think hiking areas should limit the number of visitors. What do you think?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi David! Yes, I agree that popular areas should limit visitors. I think so because too many people damage paths and leave rubbish. For example, some national parks already ask hikers to book a ticket online.

mk7-w4.intro: Email từ câu lạc bộ: "Dear member, The Hiking Club is planning a two-day trip to the mountains next month. We need to decide whether to stay in a hotel or go camping, and what activities to include. We would welcome your suggestions."
mk7-w4.title: Viết 2 email
mk7-w4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
mk7-w4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of the club. Write about your feelings and where you would like to stay.
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Quang,
I'm really excited about the club's two-day trip next month.
I think it will be a great chance to relax in nature.
I'm considering suggesting camping because sleeping under the stars sounds amazing.
What do you think?
Cheers,
Long

CÂU HỎI: Write an email to the club organiser. Write about your feelings and your suggestions for accommodation and activities.
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the two-day mountain trip planned for next month. I am really excited that the club is organising a longer trip this year.
I would like to suggest camping near a lake, rather than staying in a hotel. I believe this would make the trip more memorable and help members get to know each other around a campfire. However, some members may not have tents or experience of camping.
If camping is not possible for everyone, we could stay in a simple homestay in a local village. I also suggest including a short hike at sunrise and a cooking activity with local people, so that members can learn about the culture of the area.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Vu Long

mk7-s1.title: Câu hỏi cá nhân
mk7-s1.instr: Trả lời từng câu hỏi trong khoảng 30 giây.
mk7-s1.body:
CÂU HỎI: Please tell me about your family. | 30
BÀI MẪU: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger brother and me. My father is an engineer and my mother runs a small clothes shop. My brother is still at university. We're very close, and we always have dinner together on Sunday evenings, even though we're all busy.
CÂU HỎI: What do you enjoy doing in your free time? | 30
BÀI MẪU: In my free time, I enjoy reading and playing badminton. Reading helps me relax and learn new things, while badminton keeps me fit and lets me spend time with friends. Recently, I've also started learning to cook new dishes by watching videos online.
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about the weather in your country. | 30
BÀI MẪU: Vietnam is quite a long country, so the weather varies a lot. In the north, where I live, there are four seasons: a cold winter, a warm spring, a hot and humid summer, and a cool autumn. In the south, it's hot all year round, with just a rainy season and a dry season.

mk7-s2.part: Part 2 · Describe, express opinion, give reasons
mk7-s2.title: Mô tả ảnh
mk7-s2.instr: Mô tả bức ảnh rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Nội dung ảnh được mô tả bằng chữ.
mk7-s2.body:
ẢNH: Một bà cụ ngồi trên ghế sofa, cầm máy tính bảng gọi video với cháu; một cô gái trẻ ngồi cạnh hướng dẫn bà cách dùng.
CÂU HỎI: Describe this picture. | 45
BÀI MẪU: In this picture, I can see an elderly woman sitting on a sofa in a cosy living room. She's holding a tablet, and it looks like she's making a video call, because she's smiling and waving at the screen. Next to her, there's a young woman – probably her granddaughter – who seems to be showing her how to use the device. They both look happy and relaxed. I think this picture shows how technology can help families stay in touch.
CÂU HỎI: Why do some older people find technology difficult? | 45
BÀI MẪU: I think there are several reasons. Many older people didn't grow up with computers or smartphones, so the way these devices work isn't natural for them. Small screens and buttons can also be difficult if their eyesight isn't good. In addition, some are afraid of making mistakes or being cheated online. With patient help from younger family members, however, many of them learn quite quickly.
CÂU HỎI: How has technology changed the way families communicate? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Technology has made it much easier for families to stay in contact, especially when they live far apart. For example, my cousin works in Japan, but she video-calls her parents every week. Families also use group chats to share photos and news every day. On the other hand, some people say that family members now talk less face to face, because everyone is looking at their phone during meals.

mk7-s3.title: So sánh hai ảnh
mk7-s3.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Nội dung ảnh được mô tả bằng chữ.
mk7-s3.body:
ẢNH: Ảnh 1: Một đội bóng đá trẻ đang ăn mừng bàn thắng cùng nhau trên sân.
ẢNH: Ảnh 2: Một người đang chạy bộ một mình trên con đường ven sông vào buổi sáng sớm.
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see in the two pictures. | 45
BÀI MẪU: Both pictures show people doing sport, but in very different ways. In the first picture, a group of young football players are celebrating on the pitch. They're hugging each other and shouting, so they've probably just scored a goal. The atmosphere looks very energetic. The second picture shows a man running alone along a river early in the morning. It looks calm and peaceful, and he seems focused on his own pace. So the first shows teamwork and excitement, while the second shows individual effort.
CÂU HỎI: Do you prefer team sports or individual sports? Why? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Personally, I prefer individual sports like running and swimming. The main reason is flexibility: I can exercise whenever I have free time, without needing to organise other people. I also like setting my own goals and competing against myself. However, I can see the benefits of team sports. They're more social, and they teach important skills like communication and cooperation.
CÂU HỎI: What can children learn from playing team sports? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Children can learn a lot from team sports. First, they learn to work together and understand that the team's success is more important than individual glory. Second, they learn how to win and lose gracefully, which is a valuable life skill. Team sports also teach discipline, because children have to attend training regularly and follow rules. Finally, they're a great way to make friends.

mk7-s4.title: A memorable celebration
mk7-s4.instr: Chuẩn bị 1 phút (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu.
mk7-s4.body:
ẢNH: Một gia đình nhiều thế hệ quây quần bên mâm cỗ ngày Tết, có hoa đào và bánh chưng.
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a celebration you remember well.
BÀI MẪU: I'd like to talk about last year's Lunar New Year, or Tet. It was special because my uncle's family came back from Australia after five years away. On New Year's Eve, my whole extended family – more than twenty people – gathered at my grandparents' house. We cooked traditional dishes together, such as banh chung, and at midnight we watched the fireworks from the balcony.
CÂU HỎI: Why was it important to you?
BÀI MẪU: It was important because it was the first time in years that all of us were together. My grandparents were so happy that they cried. It reminded me how much family means to me, and how lucky I am to have such a close relationship with my relatives.
CÂU HỎI: Are traditional celebrations becoming less important in modern society? Why?
BÀI MẪU: In some ways, I think they are changing rather than becoming less important. Many young people now travel during Tet instead of staying at home, and some traditions, like making banh chung, are disappearing because it's easier to buy food. However, most people still see these celebrations as a time to reunite with family. In my opinion, as long as that core value remains, the traditions will survive, even if the details change.

SỐ TỪ: 1-5

SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: In the summer.

CÂU HỎI: Who do you travel with?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: My family.

CÂU HỎI: What do you like visiting?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5

wtc1-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wtc1-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wtc1-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Why are you interested in travel?
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I am interested in travel because I love exploring new places. I enjoy it because I learn about local cultures. For example, I tried making lanterns in Hoi An.

wtc1-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wtc1-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wtc1-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time you had a trip in bad weather.
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Last summer, my family visited Da Lat during the rainy season. I was disappointed because it rained almost every day. As a result, we stayed in the hotel playing cards and missed the famous waterfalls.

CÂU HỎI: Travelling long distances by some means of transport is not good for the environment. Do you agree?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, I agree that long journeys can harm the environment. I think so because planes and cars produce a lot of carbon emissions. I also believe taking a train or sharing a car is a greener choice.

CÂU HỎI: What are the most interesting places to visit in your country?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I think Ha Long Bay is the most interesting place in Vietnam. I love it because the limestone islands are amazing in the morning. I also recommend taking a boat trip and visiting a fishing village.

CÂU HỎI: What is the most exciting journey you have been on?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! My most exciting journey was a four-day trip to Vung Tau with friends. I enjoyed it because we climbed to the lighthouse and watched the sunrise. I also loved trying fresh seafood on the beach.

CÂU HỎI: Can you remember the first time you went on a journey by yourself? What was it like?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Yes, my first solo journey was a bus trip to Ninh Binh when I was eighteen. I was nervous because I had never travelled alone. However, I felt very proud and independent when I arrived.

wtc1-p4.intro: Email từ câu lạc bộ: "Dear members, Our club is planning to encourage more tourists to visit our area. We also want visitors to behave politely and respect our local community. Please give us your suggestions for this plan."
wtc1-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wtc1-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wtc1-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of the club. Share your feelings and your suggestions.
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Minh,
I'm really excited about the club's plan to attract more visitors.
I think short videos of local attractions on social media would work well.
I'm considering making a simple guide about local customs.
What do you think?
Best,
Quyen

CÂU HỎI: Write an email to the president of the club. Share your feelings and give your suggestions.
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the club's plan to attract more tourists to our area. I am very pleased that the club also wants visitors to respect our local community.
I would like to suggest posting short videos about walking routes, local food and friendly residents on the club's website and social media. I believe this would show visitors what makes our area special. However, more tourists may also bring more noise and rubbish.
If it is not possible to control this with rules, we could give visitors a short guide about local customs when they arrive. I also suggest asking local guides to remind tourists to dress properly at temples and to ask permission before taking photographs.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Tran Hoang Quyen

SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Old buildings.

CÂU HỎI: Where would you like to go next?

wtc2-p2.title: Viết đoạn ngắn
wtc2-p2.instr: Trả lời bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
wtc2-p2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell us about a place you often visit.
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I often visit a small park near my home. I go there because it is quiet and green. For example, I walk around the lake every Sunday morning.

wtc2-p3.title: Trả lời nhóm chat
wtc2-p3.instr: Trả lời các thành viên trong nhóm chat, mỗi câu 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
wtc2-p3.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe your recent holiday.
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! Last month, I spent three days in Hoi An with my sister. I loved it because we cycled through the rice fields. I also enjoyed walking by the river at night when the lanterns came on.

CÂU HỎI: Tell us about the holiday you liked the most.
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! My favourite holiday was a weekend in Hue with my parents. I liked it because we explored the Imperial City slowly. I also enjoyed a peaceful boat trip on the Perfume River at sunset.

CÂU HỎI: Some people like taking photos when they are on holiday. What is your opinion?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi! I think taking a few photos on holiday is a good idea. I believe this because photos help us remember special moments. However, I usually put my phone away so I can enjoy the place.

wtc2-p4.intro: Email từ câu lạc bộ: "Dear members, The club would like to help people who are travelling abroad for the first time. We are looking for suggestions on how to prepare them for the trip and how they can communicate more easily while abroad."
wtc2-p4.title: Viết 2 email
wtc2-p4.instr: Email cho bạn khoảng 50 từ (thân mật) và email cho quản lý 120–150 từ (trang trọng). Khoảng 30 phút.
wtc2-p4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of the club. Share your feelings and your suggestions.
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Minh,
I'm really pleased about the club's idea of helping first-time travellers.
I think a simple checklist of documents and emergency contacts would help.
I'm considering suggesting an offline translation app for people who cannot speak English.
What do you think?
Best,
Quyen

CÂU HỎI: Write an email to the president of the club. Share your feelings and give your suggestions.
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about how the club can support members who are travelling abroad for the first time. I am very pleased that the club is starting this useful project.
I would like to suggest creating a short guide with a checklist of documents, emergency numbers and transport options from the airport. I believe this would help first-time travellers feel more confident. However, many of them may still worry about speaking a foreign language.
If face-to-face classes are not possible, we could hold an online session where experienced members teach common phrases for asking directions and ordering food. I also suggest recommending an offline translation app, because the internet may be limited in some places.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Tran Hoang Quyen
